name: research_demo_static
description: MODE B - static navigation, in the same DNS_Research_World.wbt as the dynamic scene. The crossing obstacle is parked at the arena edge so only the two pillars obstruct the route. Using one world for both modes keeps the geometry, lighting and camera identical, so the only difference between the static and dynamic experiments is whether the third obstacle moves.
_parking_note: The mover keeps motion type 'oscillate' with amplitude 0 rather than type 'static'. The backend only skips supervisor repositioning for type 'static', so amplitude 0 makes it actively pinned to the parked coordinate every step. Parked at y = -2.55, which is 2.55 m off the route and clear of the left wall by 3.0 - 2.55 - 0.5 = 0.0 m at the wall face... it sits flush to the wall, out of the navigable corridor.
